_note: Every number has a source tag: FACTS = public source (see docs/FACTS.md), DERIVED = calculated from public figures, PLACEHOLDER = made up for the prototype (listed in docs/PLACEHOLDERS.md).

analog_year.src: Weather after the last real day is copied from Oct 2021 onward (same dates) and labelled simulated. Chosen because Oct 2021 was a real early-snow year (FACTS 1b): 22 cm on 23 Oct at the sector grid point, then clear and -15 to -22 C

per_man_day.src: PLACEHOLDER: ration weight incl. packing, kg per man per day
PLACEHOLDER: litres per man per day at +10 C

extra_per_degC_below_10.src: PLACEHOLDER: extra litres per man per day for each degree below +10 C (heating)

cold_factor_per_degC_below_0.src: PLACEHOLDER: batteries drain faster in cold

payload_kg.src: PLACEHOLDER: light truck on forward roads

jeep_payload_kg.src: PLACEHOLDER: light vehicle on jeep tracks

jeep_cost_factor.src: PLACEHOLDER: cost per kg-km on jeep tracks compared with trucks

drive_hours_per_day.src: PLACEHOLDER: daylight driving hours in mountains

cost_inr_per_kg_km.src: DERIVED: Rs 1 lakh per 10-tonne round trip Srinagar-Leh (~420 km one way), The Week 2020 (FACTS 5)

payload_kg_by_alt_m.src: PLACEHOLDER curve; the 200 kg at ~21,000 ft point is the public Dhruv requirement (FACTS 5)

cost_inr_per_hour.src: DERIVED: ~Rs 4 lakh per 45-min sortie, The Week 2020 (FACTS 5)

handling_hours.src: PLACEHOLDER: loading and unloading time per sortie

max_cloud_pct.src: PLACEHOLDER: proxy for visibility (Open-Meteo archive has no visibility)

payload_kg_by_band.src: FACTS 3: 15 kg high altitude / 20 kg medium altitude, Army RFP (Tribune, Oct 2022). No separate public figure below 6,000 ft, so the medium figure is used

range_km_one_way.src: FACTS 3: lowest public figure (RFIs say 10-20 km)

cost_inr_per_sortie.src: PLACEHOLDER: battery, wear and crew time

max_wind_kmh.src: PLACEHOLDER: no public wind limit found

payload_kg.src: FACTS 4: lower public figure (40-72.5 kg reported)

max_snow_depth_m.src: PLACEHOLDER: track usable below this snow depth

payload_kg.src: FACTS 4: middle of the 10-30 kg range

helicopters.src: PLACEHOLDER: utility helicopters available to Sector X

heli_hours_per_day.src: PLACEHOLDER: total flying hours per day for the sector

red_days.src: Team choice: red if stock may run out within 7 days (bad-case demand)

amber_days.src: Team choice: amber if within 14 days

confidence.src: Team choice: plan on the date the route is still open with 80% probability

threshold_factor.src: PLACEHOLDER: forward roads and tracks are not cleared like national highways, so they close at this fraction of the fitted Manali-Leh snow threshold

snow_per_1000m.src: PLACEHOLDER: extra snowfall share per 1,000 m above 4,000 m

track_reopen_lag_days.src: PLACEHOLDER: forward roads and tracks reopen this long after the Manali-Leh highway
